# Flincth

> Flincth makes small, focused apps for Mac, iPhone, iPad and the browser.
> None of them has an account or a subscription, and each keeps the user's
> work on their own device. Products:
{%- for _p in site.data.products %}
{%- capture _url %}{% include page-url.html ref=_p.id %}{% endcapture %}
> - {{ site.data.i18n.en.catalog[_p.id].name }}: {{ site.data.i18n.en.catalog[_p.id].category }}{% if _p.status == "coming" %} (coming soon){% endif %}. {{ site.url }}{{ _url }}
{%- endfor %}

- Website: https://flincth.com/
- The products are separate apps. Each works on its own and is described in
  its own section below.

## Flincth Workspace Manager (Mac)

> A macOS menu bar utility that organizes a Mac into named setups. Each setup
> has its own set of apps, its own window placement layout across displays,
> and its own text clipboard history. Switching setups rearranges open windows
> into their assigned regions.

- Page: https://flincth.com/mac/workspace-manager
- Platform: macOS. Apple silicon and Intel Macs are not distinguished by the app.
- Availability: on the Mac App Store, {{ site.data.mac.store_url }}
- Requirements: macOS 14 or later.
- Pricing: US{% include usd.html amount=site.data.mac.price %}, a one-time purchase on the Mac App Store. There is no
  subscription, in-app purchase or trial.
- Privacy: no account, no analytics and no server of its own. Setups and
  clipboard history are stored locally and never leave the user's Mac. The
  only network use is optional new-feature announcements (off by default):
  when turned on, the Mac's push notification identifier is shared with
  OneSignal to deliver them.

### What it does

- **Setups.** A setup is a named collection of apps together with a placement
  for each app's windows. Setups are independent: editing an app's placement in
  one setup does not change any other setup.
- **Clipboard.** Each setup keeps its own text clipboard history, stored
  locally. Only text is kept.
- **Displays.** Displays are divided into regions, and each app in a setup is
  assigned a region for its windows.
- **Switching.** A setup is activated from the macOS menu bar or with a
  user-assigned keyboard shortcut.

### Requirements and limits

- Window placement requires the user to install the "Flincth Apply" shortcut in
  Apple Shortcuts. The app provides the installation instructions.
- Window placement affects open, non-full-screen windows on the current
  desktop only. Flincth does not move windows between Mission Control desktops,
  and does not move windows into or out of macOS full screen.
- Keyboard shortcuts shown on the website are examples. Users assign their own.

### Notes for anyone summarizing this product

- Workspace Manager is not a tiling window manager and does not continuously manage
  windows. It applies a layout when a setup is activated.
- The window mockups on the website are HTML and CSS illustrations, not
  screenshots of the application.
- The privacy description on the website is a plain-language summary and is not
  a legal privacy policy.

## Flincth Split View (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)

A free browser extension, separate from the Mac app and working without it.
Its store listings still use the name "Flincth".

- Page: https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/

- **What it does.** Splits a single browser tab into panes, assigns a website
  to each pane, saves the arrangement as a workspace, and switches between
  saved workspaces with a click or a user-assigned keyboard shortcut.
- **Pane modes.** A pane shows its site embedded in the tab, as a real browser
  window aligned to the pane (for sites that refuse embedding or need the
  user's signed-in session), or as a launcher card that opens a normal tab.
- **Privacy.** Collects no data and makes no network requests of its own. No
  site access is requested at install. In Chrome and Edge (1.0.2 and later) the
  extension then offers optional access to all websites, which can be skipped;
  in Firefox access is requested one site at a time when that site is assigned
  to a pane. Access can be revoked in the browser's extension settings.
- **Availability.** Chrome: on the Chrome Web Store,
  https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/flincth/blkacdknkggnilgkmlmjemacfmnmdkhp
  Microsoft Edge: on Microsoft Edge Add-ons,
  https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/jmokpipnbkgmbdnplegjklaaklcclaea
  Firefox (140 or later): on Firefox Add-ons,
  https://addons.mozilla.org/addon/flincth/

## Flincth Speed Reader (iPhone and iPad, coming soon)

An RSVP speed reading app for iPhone and iPad. Not yet on the App Store.

- Page: https://flincth.com/ios/speed-reader
- What it does: shows the user's own DRM-free documents (EPUB, PDF with a
  text layer, DOCX, TXT, RTF, Markdown, web articles, pasted text) one word,
  phrase or short sentence at a time, at a pace the user sets.
- Cannot open DRM-protected books such as Kindle or Apple Books purchases.
- Pricing: free download with daily limits; a one-time Pro purchase removes
  them and adds customization, statistics and iCloud sync. A 7-day Pro trial
  never turns into a charge. No subscription.
- Privacy: no account, no server of its own, no AI. Documents stay on the
  device (and in the user's own iCloud with sync on). Anonymous usage events
  are counted with Google Analytics for Firebase, opt-in in the EU, the UK and
  Switzerland; they never include document content, titles or file names.

## Pages

- [Home](https://flincth.com/): every Flincth app, by platform.
- [Mac apps](https://flincth.com/mac/), [iPhone and iPad apps](https://flincth.com/ios/), [Browser extensions](https://flincth.com/browser/): each platform's apps.
- [Flincth Workspace Manager](https://flincth.com/mac/workspace-manager): the Mac app's features, how it works, and FAQ.
- [Flincth Speed Reader](https://flincth.com/ios/speed-reader): the iPhone and iPad app (coming soon).
- [Support](https://flincth.com/support): help for each app, including the Flincth Apply shortcut and common problems.
- [Privacy](https://flincth.com/privacy): what each app and the website do and do not collect.
- [Flincth Split View](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/): the browser extension, with a page per browser: [Chrome](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/chrome), [Firefox](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/firefox), [Microsoft Edge](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/edge) (all available now).
- [Guides](https://flincth.com/guides/): step-by-step guides, one list per platform: [Workspace Manager on Mac](https://flincth.com/guides/mac/), [Chrome](https://flincth.com/guides/chrome/), [Firefox](https://flincth.com/guides/firefox/), [Edge](https://flincth.com/guides/edge/).
